2.1.17._note: Re-captured on Factorio 2.1.17 (build 87315) on 2026-09-14, the first 2.1 run since the 0.3.2-era capture and the first ever of the customizer on a 2.1 engine, against FkRecipes v0.1.1 (its science-pack question is engine-keyed: subgroup science-pack on 2.1, where data.raw.tool no longer exists; a recipe's category is emitted as 2.1's categories). What moved and why, arm by arm: BASE data_raw_sha256 and prototype_list_checksum, because 0.3.3's freeze fix points the legacy stub item's place_result at a stub entity that becomes a real part on the next tick, which is one more prototype on the base set (the same field is the only prototype difference against the 0.3.2 release on 2.0.77, measured by the 28-pair proof); INCUMBENT data_raw_sha256 UNMOVED to the digit from the 0.3.2-era capture, which is the customizer changing no prototype on the defaults; BOTH arms' mod_settings_sha256, because the two dropdowns gained their composed descriptions and the four customizer settings arrived (the same hash on both mod sets, as on 2.0.77). Every variant, note, remover and demote-era arm passed on this engine before the capture was taken. RE-CAPTURED AGAIN ON 2026-09-14, FOR THE CURVED-EXIT FEATURE rebased onto that same head, and the whole move is ONE line of dump per half. `mod_settings_sha256` on BOTH arms (5c538a590d0f0a49 -> 87d351968e34ece6, the same hash on both mod sets as it has always been): `bbb-curved-exits`, the runtime-global bool behind the curve rule, is a NEW SETTING at order `b` with `default_value` true, and it is the only entry either settings dump gained -- read off a `jq -S` diff of the normalised settings dumps either side, which is that one prototype and nothing else. `data_raw_sha256` on BOTH arms (base c53439bc85112b8c -> 4b8bb9de68ab47fe, incumbent 4ffb0e3b68f149d8 -> 9adb38903eebd055): `bbb-linked-belt` gains "fast_replaceable_group": "transport-belt", which is what lets a belt replace an EDGE part, and a `jq -S` diff of the normalised data-raw dumps either side is ONE LINE on each arm. THE INCUMBENT ARM MOVING IS THE POINT here rather than a surprise, and it is the exact opposite of the stub's `place_result` above: `bbb-linked-belt` is this mod's own hidden belt and exists whoever owns `balancer-part`, so a change to it has to reach both mod sets or it did not happen. `prototype_list_checksum` is UNMOVED on both arms, 4218601359 and 2044872442, which is that instrument's documented blindness to a field value met again; the check prints no note for it. THE CONTROL WAS TAKEN FIRST: master's own rows were re-run green on this binary, from a tree built at master, before the rebased tree was dumped at all, so the drift recorded here is the feature's and not the machine's.
